NEET MDS and UG Counselling Registrations Open

The Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) has commenced registration for the third round of NEET MDS 2026 counselling. Separately, the Madhya Pradesh NEET UG 2026 Mop-Up Round has released a revised merit list with updated dates for choice filling.
